title: PBKDF2 min constraints now provider-declared — no framework backstop
description: Before this commit, crypto2dev_fd.c enforced SP 800-132 PBKDF2 minimums via strncmp('pbkdf2'...). This commit moves enforcement to ops->min_iterations and ops->min_salt_len populated by providers. The strncmp guard was removed from fd.c. A future provider implementing PBKDF2 that forgets to set these fields will silently bypass enforcement. The old approach was brittle but exhaustive; the new approach is clean but relies on provider discipline. Mitigation: add a framework-level rule in the provider registration path that asserts: if algo contains 'pbkdf2', then min_iterations >= 1000 and min_salt_len >= 16.
